notes.title: Matrix Games is the new Home of Combat Mission
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce the [b]acquisition of Battlefront[/b], the renowned developers behind the Combat Mission series. 

[h2]ELEVATING COMBAT MISSION'S LEGACY[/h2]
This strategic move underscores our commitment to the wargaming community and the legacy of Combat Mission—a franchise celebrated for its unmatched tactical and strategic depth. With [b]over 1 million copies sold worldwide[/b], Combat Mission remains a defining force in the genre, setting the standard for authentic warfare simulations.

[previewyoutube=u3OwoL7A4RE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]LOOKING FORWARD[/h2]
This acquisition marks a new chapter for Combat Mission, as we plan to enhance the series with cutting-edge technology and innovative gameplay, all while preserving the core elements that have made it a favorite among wargamers for [b]over 25 years[/b].

[b]Battlefront's entire team[/b], including the original creators, [b]will be joining Slitherine[/b], ensuring the continuity and quality that fans have come to expect.

This partnership makes a milestone in wargaming, with Slitherine and Battlefront committed to delivering the best possible experience and ensuring the continued growth and success of the Combat Mission franchise.

[h2]AVAILABILITY & DISTRIBUTION[/h2]
Combat Mission titles [b]will continue to be available[/b] on all current platforms, including Matrix Games and Steam. To help both new and existing players, we have updated our [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/battlefront-acquisition-faq]FAQ[/url] and "[url=https://www.matrixgames.com/combat-mission-how-to-download-my-games]How to Download My Games[/url]" sections, making it easier than ever to access and enjoy the series.

[h2]A DAY OF CELEBRATION[/h2]
To celebrate this exciting milestone, we're thrilled to offer [b]discounts of up to 60%[/b] on all Combat Mission titles. This is a [b]limited-time sale[/b], available until September 3rd, so don't miss out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/combatmissionfranchisesale


Additionally, we have organized a full day of streaming on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/slitherinetv/schedule]Twitch channel[/url]. The schedule includes a variety of Combat Mission titles, showcasing gameplay and strategies. Join us to experience our streamers in action and engage with our community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772341/81576c3109a93360acd451e5856c3d135c4091e5.jpg[/img]

We are also pleased to announce the opening of subscriptions for a new Battle for Normandy [url=https://www.slitherine.com/tournaments]tournament[/url] featuring [b]three brand new maps[/b]. These maps have been meticulously crafted, all starting from the master map of the Battle Pack 2.

Enjoy this Combat Mission milestone and celebration and [b]don’t miss[/b] this perfect opportunity to expand your collection and dive into the acclaimed tactical warfare series at an unbeatable price.

notes.title: Final Blitzkrieg and Downfall DLC - Out Now
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kb-ZKVTMPUY;full][/previewyoutube]

Combat Mission Final Blitzkrieg and its DLC Downfall, are now available.

Combat Mission Final Blitzkrieg follows the Western Allies through the battles along Germany's border and into the heart of the Reich itself. The game covers the October 1944 through January 1945 timeframe with a focus on the American sector of the Battle of the Bulge.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676000/Combat_Mission_Final_Blitzkrieg/

Join the assault into Germany! Command the late-war British, Canadian, and Polish forces through to VE Day, 8 May 1945, or take charge of desperate ad-hoc German forces and Volkssturm. In this DLC you can wield Comets, Pershings,and other late-war equipment through three campaigns (totaling twenty-four missions), ten standalone scenarios, and dozens of new Quick Battle maps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2736420/Combat_Mission_Final_Blitzkrieg__Downfall/

To celebrate the launch on Steam and Matrix Games, the base game will be [b]discounted by 30%[/b], while the Combat Mission Final Blitzkrieg Complete Bundle will be discounted at [b]10% off for a limited time[/b].

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/37950/Combat_Mission_Final_Blitzkrieg_Complete/

[b]Anyone with a copy of the game purchased on Battlefront.com will also be able to redeem a Steam key [url=https://www.slitherine.com/member/registerserial]HERE[/url] using their original game code. If you want to know how to do it, all details can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1369370/discussions/0/2798378453072542697/?snr=1_2108_9__2107]here[/url][/b]

Last but not least, we are excited to announce the opening of [b]sign-ups for a new tournament[/b].

The Tournament will begin [b]February 5, 2024[/b].

This Tournament will feature 3 rounds with a different scenario each one. The round time is 50 days.

[i]Last Man Out- Remnants of 17th Armored Infantry Battalion attempt escape from Herrlisheim. Axis probe

Trouble with Siegfried- Forward US elements meet the Westwall. Allied attack.

Cutline to Grosshaw – Opposing infantry platoons clash during a fighting patrol into the Hurtgen Forrest. Meeting engagement[/i]
 
Before joining the tournament, please take a moment and carefully read these instructions that are specific to all Combat Mission Tournaments.
 
- Because of the way that Combat Mission’s original “play by email” system works, both game
files have an in-game field for password protection of the file. This field should be left blank. For the
Allied side the password has been selected before the battles were sent and that field is to be
left blank. You can use a password for the Axis side but it isn’t needed because the Tournament
feature handles protection from cheating without using the in game system.

- The Tournament will have you playing 2 individual battles where you are playing both sides of
the same battle. If you get into the game before your opponent, you will see 1 game turn to play. If
your opponent has gotten there first then you will see 2 turn files and each turn thereafter should
have 2 files.

 - Once a tournament begins you will receive the files in the "Saved Game and PBEM"; drop menu
under Automated PBEM++ In Progress. You will receive email notifications when your opponent has
sent you turns. 
- When logging in you MUST use the email address associated with your Martix account 
- You will need a Matrix user name and password to play any tournament (or PBEM++ battle).

You can sign up [url=https://www.matrixgames.com/tournaments]here[/url]. Don't miss it.
